menu_options.presets: Presets: light, climate and cover settings

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: The ready-made settings wall keys and programs use. Press a title to open it, press again to close it.{error}

light.name: Light
light.description: What the lights do when a wall key is pressed. An empty field is left unchanged.

data_description.default_templates: Advanced, optional: a Jinja template that computes a value, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}". It replaces the field above.
data_description.default_color_temp_kelvin: White instead of a colour: 2000 K warm, 6500 K cold. Fill in a colour or a white tone, not both.
data_description.dim_templates: Advanced, optional: a Jinja template that computes a value, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}". It replaces the field above.
data_description.dim_color_temp_kelvin: White instead of a colour: 2000 K warm, 6500 K cold. Fill in a colour or a white tone, not both.
data_description.night_templates: Advanced, optional: a Jinja template that computes a value, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}". It replaces the field above.
data_description.night_color_temp_kelvin: White instead of a colour: 2000 K warm, 6500 K cold. Fill in a colour or a white tone, not both.
data_description.default_state: A single press and the end of a program bring the light back to this setting.
data_description.dim_brightness_pct: Double press: only the brightness changes, the colour stays.
data_description.night_rgb_color: Long press: only the colour changes, the brightness stays.

climate.name: Climate
climate.description: The setting thermostats return to when a program ends.

data_description.default_templates: Advanced, optional: a Jinja template that computes a value, e.g. brightness_pct: "{{ 30 if is_state('sun.sun','below_horizon') else 100 }}". It replaces the field above.

cover.name: Cover
cover.description: Where the covers go at sunrise, at sunset and when a program ends.

data_description.default_current_position: 0 closed, 100 fully open. A number or a template; the current template opens by day and closes at night.

services.title: Services
services.description: Which service do you want to set up?

menu_options.budget_thuis: Budget Thuis: electricity and gas usage

immich.title: Immich
immich.description: Sorts photos into person and trip albums automatically. Press a title to open it, press again to close it.{error}

data_description.url: Leave empty to turn the Immich automation off.
data_description.scan_interval: Hours, minutes, seconds. All zero: only when the sync button is pressed.
data_description.owner: Person and trip albums are created in this user's account; the others are added as editors.
data_description.share_albums: When on, every album a user owns (hand-made ones too) is shared with the other users.

data_description.users: A name and that user's Immich API key per user (Immich > Account settings > API keys). A stored key is hidden; the eye icon shows it.

data_description.people: One line per person: person: album. Left is the name of the recognised person in Immich, right the album that collects all their photos. E.g. Kaan: Kaan

data.distance_km: How far from home counts as a trip

data_description.distance_km: The first photo taken this far from home starts a trip, the first one at home ends it. Each trip gets its own album (e.g. antalya_2025).
data_description.advanced: Optional. min_days: shortest trip in a country (e.g. netherlands: 2 = day trips inside the Netherlands are no trips); detail: which countries use the province or city name; names: how country names are written in album names.

faceless.name: Photos without faces
faceless.description: Only new uploads: images without a face, not a favourite and not put in an album by hand (screenshots, labels, receipts). Videos are never touched.

data_description.home: What happens to a photo without faces taken outside a trip.
data_description.trip: What happens to a photo without faces taken on a trip. Into the trip album: it joins that trip's album even without faces.
data_description.wait: Waits this long after the upload so Immich can finish face detection.

data_description.username: The daycare's Partou photos are copied to Immich daily, into monthly albums. Leave empty to turn it off.
data_description.password: The stored password is hidden; the eye icon shows it.

budget_thuis.title: Budget Thuis
budget_thuis.description: This month's electricity, gas and returned electricity totals as sensors. Status: {budget_thuis}.{error}

data_description.username: Budget Thuis has no password: saving mails a login link to this address. With the app password gungors reads that mail itself; without it you paste the link on the next page. Leave empty to turn it off.
data_description.mail_password: When set, gungors reads the login mail itself (no link to paste) and logs in again on its own when the login expires. Gmail does not take the normal password: create one under Google Account > Security > App passwords. The stored password shows hidden (the eye shows it); leave it as is to keep it.
data_description.new_login: Turn on when the connection is lost: a new login link is mailed.
data_description.scan_interval: Hours, minutes, seconds. 01:00:00 = hourly (at least 5 minutes).

budget_thuis_link.title: Budget Thuis: login link
budget_thuis_link.description: A mail was sent to {email}. Do NOT click the login link: right-click it, copy the link and paste it here. (If you clicked it and the browser stopped at budgetthuis://login_success?code=..., paste that.){error}

progress.budget_thuis_mail: A login mail was asked for {email}; gungors is waiting for it and reading it. This can take two minutes.

abort.sync_started: Sync started. Follow it on sensor.immich.
abort.immich_off: Immich is off: set an address in the Immich settings first.

options.trash: Move to the trash (recoverable for 30 days)
options.keep: Leave it as it is, in no album

yaml_ignored.title: gungors: presets/Immich in YAML are ignored
yaml_ignored.description: They are set under Settings > Devices & services > gungors > Configure now. Remove {keys} from YAML.
